events.name: DERIVATION_UPDATED
events.description: The derivation state after each learner action — a composed listener (readout, grader) can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.
events.synonyms: derivation update, proof step, derived line, candidate applied, goal reached

events.name: LEARN_ROUND_COMPLETE
events.description: Fired once when the step that derives the goal fact lands — the standard learning completion broadcast a celebration/progression sibling (fx cues, badges) rides.
events.synonyms: round complete, finished, done, completion, goal reached

events.name: MODE_SELECTED
events.description: Lab router broadcast naming the active mode; this instrument renders when the mode equals matchMode, otherwise renders null.

events.name: APPLY_STEP
events.description: Learner clicked a candidate-step button to try to derive the next line: the candidate's matchSide/matchNegationMode is matched against the current lines, and on success its deriveSide/deriveNegationMode determines the appended line.

events.name: TOGGLE_RUN
events.description: Learner toggled auto-derive: while running, the tick applies the first applicable candidate automatically every autoApplyIntervalMs.

events.name: RESET
events.description: Learner reset the derivation: lines restore to the config-declared starting premises, feedback/narration clear, and goalReached/running reset.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Auto-Apply Interval (ms)
overridableConfigKeys.description: Milliseconds of running clock per automatic candidate application — the 32ms base tick accumulates elapsed time and applies the first applicable candidate each time this interval elapses.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Auto Run
overridableConfigKeys.description: When true, INIT/MODE_SELECTED/Reset start the tick auto-applying candidates; toggle live with the Run/Pause button.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Auto Run Off Message
overridableConfigKeys.description: Feedback shown when Run is toggled off (Pause).

overridableConfigKeys.default: Auto-stepping — tick applies the next available step.
overridableConfigKeys.label: Auto Run On Message
overridableConfigKeys.description: Feedback shown when Run is toggled on.

default.label: Forward Rule
default.noMatchFeedback: No matching premises yet for the forward rule.

default.label: Backward Rule
default.noMatchFeedback: No matching premises yet for the backward rule.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Candidates
overridableConfigKeys.description: Candidate steps offered as buttons. Each declares which side of a link it matches against a current fact (matchSide/matchNegationMode) and which side it derives (deriveSide/deriveNegationMode) — left/right and same/opposite/invert are structural roles, not domain vocabulary, so the same two candidates can encode modus ponens/modus tollens, a forward/backward chemical rule, or any other two-sided derivation pair.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: candidate, rule, step, inference rule, derivation rule, deduction rule

overridableConfigKeys.label: Goal
overridableConfigKeys.description: The line label the learner is trying to derive; goalReached fires when a newly derived line's label equals this.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Goal Caption Prefix
overridableConfigKeys.description: Text prepended to goalLabel to form the goal caption shown above the derivation panel.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Goal Reached Message
overridableConfigKeys.description: Caption shown once goalReached is true.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Height
overridableConfigKeys.description: Maximum height of the scrollable derivation panel, in pixels.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Match Mode
overridableConfigKeys.description: When composed behind a lab router, the MODE_SELECTED mode value this instrument responds to. Empty string means standalone — render immediately on INIT.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Negation Symbol
overridableConfigKeys.description: Prefix prepended to a derived line's label when it is negated.

overridableConfigKeys.default: No further steps are available yet.
overridableConfigKeys.label: No Step Available Message
overridableConfigKeys.description: Feedback shown when the auto-apply tick finds no applicable candidate.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Premises
overridableConfigKeys.description: The starting lines of the derivation: plain facts (subject/negated) and two-sided links (leftSubject/leftNegated/rightSubject/rightNegated) the learner combines with candidate steps. Each line carries its own badgeLabel/badgeVariant.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: premise, given, starting line, hypothesis, starting statement

overridableConfigKeys.label: Reset Button Label
overridableConfigKeys.description: Label text for the button that restores the starting premises.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Title
overridableConfigKeys.description: Title shown above the derivation panel.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Width
overridableConfigKeys.description: Maximum width of the panel, in pixels.
